name: agent-windows
description: Windows Computer-Use CLI for AI Agents (MCP server)
long_description: agent-windows is a Windows Computer-Use CLI for AI Agents. It drives the real Windows desktop — screenshots, the UIA accessibility tree, vision-based element grounding, and mouse/keyboard automation — through a fast native-launcher + Python-daemon architecture. Bring your own multimodal model (GPT-4o-mini, Claude, Gemini) for locating icon-only or custom-drawn UI that the accessibility tree can't see. Any MCP-capable client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) can drive Windows through the bundled MCP server.

vlm_api_key.title: Vision Model API Key
vlm_api_key.description: API key for the multimodal model used by ground/detect/ask-vision. Optional — only needed for vision-based element location. Stored via the CLI (config set vlm.api_key), DPAPI-encrypted at rest, never logged.

telemetry.title: Local-only Tool Telemetry
telemetry.description: Append each tool call's name, success/failure and duration to ~/.agent-windows/logs/telemetry.log. Zero network, off by default.

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Launch an application by name (e.g., 'notepad') or path.

tools.name: app_list
tools.description: List all visible windows.

tools.name: app_resize
tools.description: Resize a window by name/title.

tools.name: app_switch
tools.description: Switch focus to a window by name/title.

tools.name: ask_vision
tools.description: Free-form visual Q&A: send a screenshot (or a supplied image) plus a prompt to the vision model and return its textual answer.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Execute multiple daemon commands in one IPC round-trip.

tools.name: cleanup_screenshots
tools.description: Delete old/oversized screenshots from the agent-windows data dir (~/.agent-windows/screenshots).

tools.name: click
tools.description: Mouse click at [x, y] or at a UI element (@eN selector from a prior snapshot).

tools.name: clipboard_get
tools.description: Get clipboard content.

tools.name: clipboard_set
tools.description: Set clipboard content.

tools.name: collapse
tools.description: Collapse an expandable UI element at @eN (ComboBox/TreeItem/Menu). Idempotent.

tools.name: dblclick
tools.description: Double-click at [x, y] or at a UI element (@eN).

tools.name: detect
tools.description: Detect multiple targets matching a description and return a bounding box per match (plus a marked screenshot).

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Pixel-level diff between a baseline screenshot and another image (or a fresh capture when compare is omitted).

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2).

tools.name: element_state
tools.description: Check whether a UIA element (@eN) is visible or enabled.

tools.name: expand
tools.description: Expand an expandable UI element at @eN (ComboBox/TreeItem/Menu). Idempotent.

tools.name: find_image
tools.description: Locate a template image file on screen and return click-ready coordinates (deterministic, no vision-model call). Use when you have a saved image of the target; use ground when you have a description.

tools.name: fs_copy
tools.description: Copy a file/dir.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Delete a file/dir.

tools.name: fs_info
tools.description: Return metadata (size/dates/type) for a file or directory.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List a directory.

tools.name: fs_move
tools.description: Move/rename a file/dir.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read a text file.

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Find files/dirs matching a glob pattern (recursive by default).

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Write to a file.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Return the text/name of a UIA element identified by its @eN selector from a prior snapshot.

tools.name: ground
tools.description: Locate a UI element by natural-language description and return click-ready coordinates [x, y], confidence, and a marked screenshot.

tools.name: highlight
tools.description: Draw a labeled rectangle over a region [x1,y1,x2,y2] on a screenshot and return the marked image.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover at [x, y] or @eN to trigger tooltips/highlights.

tools.name: key_down
tools.description: Press key(s) (raw key-down). With hold N, auto-release after N seconds; without, stays pressed (pair with key_up).

tools.name: key_up
tools.description: Release key(s) (raw key-up). Pair with key_down.

tools.name: mouse_down
tools.description: Press and hold a mouse button at [x, y] or @eN.

tools.name: mouse_up
tools.description: Release a mouse button at [x, y] or @eN.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor to [x, y] or @eN (without clicking).

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.description: Type into multiple fields in one call.

tools.name: multi_select
tools.description: Click multiple targets in one call.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show a Windows toast notification.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Combined observation: snapshot + screenshot (+ optional visual grounding), returned as text.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Daemon health check (single IPC round-trip).

tools.name: pixel_at
tools.description: Read the color at a screen point; with match, return is_match within tolerance. Deterministic, no vision-model call.

tools.name: process_kill
tools.description: Kill a process by PID (int) or name (str).

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List running processes with PID, name, memory, and CPU time.

tools.name: registry
tools.description: Windows Registry operation.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the screen (or a region/monitor/element).

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll at [x, y] or @eN.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a PowerShell command and return stdout/stderr.

tools.name: shortcut
tools.description: Send a keyboard shortcut, e.g. "ctrl+c", "alt+tab", "win+r".

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Return a semantic snapshot of the UIA accessibility tree: focused window, open windows, and interactive/scrollable elements with their bounding boxes and @eN labels. Use window/active to scope to one top-level window.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text using Unicode direct input (bypasses IME).

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for a duration, an element (@eN selector) to appear, or text to appear in an interactive element's name.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until a UI condition holds.
